intro: Every Flaz project follows the same four-stage process — so you always know what happens next, who is responsible, and where your project stands.

steps.title: Survey & scoping
steps.body: We visit the site, assess the full scope, and produce a detailed written quotation — the price and scope are set out in writing before work starts.

steps.title: Dedicated oversight
steps.body: Each project has a named project manager as your point of contact.

steps.title: Live progress updates
steps.body: Weekly photo reports and progress calls so you always know exactly where your project stands — whether you're on site or overseas.

steps.title: Clean handover
steps.body: A final walkthrough, snag list cleared, and all documentation handed over. Any outstanding items are recorded and agreed with you at handover.
